_comment: DEMONSTRATION PARAMETERS, NOT PRODUCTION RECOMMENDATIONS (CTL-412). Tiny by design so a learner reaches every state in minutes at negligible cost. Change one value and watch the behaviour move. Frozen source: IMPLEMENTATION_DESIGN.md section 6.
_model_call_fraction_note: The share of an answer spent inside the model call, and so holding a downstream permit. Retrieval and the trust checks come first and hold none. At 0.5 with 4 answering permits, average model-call concurrency is 2 - which is exactly the downstream permit count, so the two limits are coherent rather than one silently masking the other.
